M01-callback-deadline-inclusive: VRF callback accepted at drawRequestedAt+2d (spec: strictly before)
M02-refunds-open-at-sale-end: refunds open during the draw-request window
M03-cash-sponsor-overallocated: CashWon sponsor share ignores the protocol fee (over-allocation)
M04-refund-without-burn: refunded tickets are not burned (double refund)
M05-sponsor-reclaims-nft-in-nftwon: sponsor can take back the NFT after the reserve was met
M07-redeem-without-owner-check: anyone can trigger redemption of the winning ticket
M08-request-window-inclusive: draw request accepted at endTime+2d (spec: half-open window)
M10-no-runtime-quote-screen: USDC payouts skip the runtime protocol-destination screen
M11-prize-release-no-flag: releaseSponsorPrize does not record the claim
M12-callback-ignores-request-id: callback for a foreign request id is accepted
